budget_fix_followup.candidate_changes: Descriptor admission during collection, lookahead admission yielding, decoder credit release, bounded headroom checks.
limitations: Integration compilation and unrelated workloads were active on the shared host; timing changes are diagnostic, not a throughput guarantee.
Seven measured samples per variant/case reuse the journal in one process; these are not seven alternating paired process runs.
Allocation counts and peak requested live bytes are identical to the original candidate measurements for all six remeasured cases.

limitations: Native macOS ARM64 shared host; compilation and unrelated work were active. Instrumented timings are diagnostic and do not establish zero overhead.

enrichment_compact_followup.method: Identical operation-aware benchmark harnesses in baseline and candidate. Replay validates counts/targets and the fixture-derived expected checksum. limitations: Native macOS ARM64, Zig 0.16.0, ReleaseFast. Shared-host compilation and other benchmark processes were active; timings are diagnostic and do not establish zero overhead.

collector_vector_metadata_followup.candidate: working tree follow-up; production and harness hashes below
collector_vector_metadata_followup.method: Native macOS ARM64, Zig 0.16.0, ReleaseFast. Identical benchmark fixtures in the previous PR head and candidate. Counted allocation uses the diagnostic C allocator; timing uses production smp without counting. Setup excluded, warmup before each measurement, alternating variant order. 20 paired collector samples for short and 80%-missing cases, 5 pairs for each of long escaped keys, sparse extraction, text materialization and packed relational rows. Vector runs use 3 pairs, 5k vectors of 128 dimensions in 128-item batches; retries are seeded from the baseline writer and every reference/value is read back.
limitations: Own compilation finished before timing; unrelated CPU-heavy workloads remained active on the shared host. Timing is diagnostic and does not establish zero overhead.
Counters track requested heap bytes, not allocator size-class rounding, physical memory or process RSS.
Vector preparation now has a fixed 2 KiB stack metadata buffer excluded from heap counters. Both collector variants already have the prior 2 KiB lookup-key stack buffer.
Collector fixtures use 50k distinct keys and small document bodies; they measure preparation/read/materialization, not full index mutation throughput.
Vector source-file measurements include Session preparation and durability. Counted metrics also include final checkpoint and statistics formatting, while run_ns excludes the final checkpoint.
Discarded intermediate reservation experiments remain untracked and are excluded from these final collector results.
